# Data Directory

This directory contains FASTQ files generated during pipeline execution.

## Generated Files

When you run the pipeline, the following files will be created:

- `Sample_1_raw.fastq` - Raw FASTQ reads for Sample 1
- `Sample_2_raw.fastq` - Raw FASTQ reads for Sample 2
- `Sample_1_trimmed.fastq` - Trimmed FASTQ reads for Sample 1
- `Sample_2_trimmed.fastq` - Trimmed FASTQ reads for Sample 2

These files are excluded from version control to keep the repository size manageable.
